description: Verification suite for AST and semantic codebase indexing, exclusion handling, and boundary containment.

test_cases.name: index-project-codebase
test_cases.description: Initiate background indexing while excluding vendor and upload files.
test_cases.input: Index custom modules and themes in /app with local-memory-indexer.
assertions: must trigger start_indexing with exclusion filters
must not execute shell commands or arbitrary file deletion

test_cases.name: doctor-index-repair
test_cases.description: Diagnose and repair inconsistent vector chunks using doctor_index.
test_cases.input: Symbol lookups are failing after module rename; run index diagnostics.
assertions: must call doctor_index before executing destructive index purges
